<thought>To locate the template that retrosynthetically disconnects the C=C double bond of the cinnamic acid side‑chain and generates an aldehyde plus malonic acid (the Doebner modification), I will search the template catalog for templates that break a “C‑C double bond” and form both an “aldehydes” and an “aliphatic carboxylic acid”. This should retrieve the desired template and its ID, after which I can obtain the mapped reaction SMILES.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)O)cc2)cc1",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["C-C double bonds"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["aldehydes", "aliphatic carboxylic acid"]
}
</action_input>
